challenge.better_approach: A sieve that reds dangling measured paths after the fact was considered. It catches rot only after the worktree is gone, when the original bytes are lost. Refusing at the door costs one check at write time and keeps the record whole. Copying the cited file into the commons was considered too; that duplicates outline text, and the main tree already holds it once a land happens.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That an absolute path names a record. Measured 2026-11-21: 34 of 319 measured answers cite paths outside this box's durable roots; 32 no longer resolve here, a mix of worktree paths (wt-2a20, wt-castpair, wt-4c4a, wt-unq, wt-q126), /tmp scratchpads and akienasus's own home paths (/home/akien/CairnCommons, /home/akien/cairn), which are durable there but not here. So the address, not the absolute path, is the record. Repointing the 32 older ones is a separate backfill, named to the orchestrator, not this ticket.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted the congruency lab's question charter (no worktree rule) and grepped tickets, questions and ideas for 'durable root' (none). cairn/machines/corrosion/citation.py already resolves the main checkout through git's common dir; the build reuses that shape rather than inventing a resolver.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive. CLAUDE.md's 'Everything we intend to share is a git file' is compatible: the commons and main tree are git; the runtime home is the one non-git durable root, admitted because measurements of runtime state (logs) live there. A distinction to record, not a conflict.

answers.falsifier: done when the door refuses a --measured record inside a linked worktree and inside a scratch dir, records a commons record as commons/<path>, and the two named questions' measured fields are rooted addresses that resolve on main; wrong intent if the main checkout cannot be found from a worktree without hardcoding this box's home path
answers.from_idea: none, because the ask is the orchestrator's (2026-11-21), and its evidence is two records on disk: CairnCommons/questions/open-2921d9c2dbb8.json and CairnCommons/questions/open-a9795e2009c1.json, whose measured field names a file under /home/akien/dev/src/wt-hostb, a worktree that is cleared when its work lands; the measurement 2026-11-21: 34 of 319 measured answers under CairnCommons/questions/ cite a record outside this box's durable roots, 32 of which no longer resolve here
answers.how: In cairn/tools/question/question.py answer(): resolve the --measured path; find the durable roots, which are the main checkout behind the cairn repo's git common dir (read from the .git file, the shape cairn/machines/corrosion/citation.py finds through git), that checkout's sibling CairnCommons, and the instance root ~/.cairn; refuse a path under none of them, naming the path and the roots; otherwise record measured as '<root>/<relative path>' and answered_by as 'measurement: <that address>'. A red-first proof plants a record in a linked git worktree of a scratch repo and one in a scratch dir and expects both refused with nothing written, and answers with a commons record and expects the rooted address. open-2921d9c2dbb8 and open-a9795e2009c1 are repointed through the artifact door to repo/<same path>, where the outline lines they cite now stand on main (c8224d38a).
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a measurement whose record vanishes becomes an unmeasured claim) and Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth: an answer is a record of truth, and its citation must not rot)
answers.what: A question answered by measurement cites a record every box can find later: the answer door records --measured as a rooted address (repo/..., commons/..., instance/..., the three roots of cairn/tools/base/address.py), and refuses a path that resolves inside none of the durable roots, so a worktree, a scratch dir or another box's absolute path never stands as the measurement.

bullets.text: Two answered questions on cffb99063d09 (open-2921d9c2dbb8, open-a9795e2009c1) cite their measurement at a worktree path; clearing wt-hostb would leave both answers citing nothing.
artifact door.roots() names a worktree's own tree when run from one, so 'inside a declared root' is not 'durable'; the main checkout is found through git's common dir.
34 of 319 measured answers cite a record outside this box's durable roots, 32 no longer resolve; an absolute path is box-relative, so the door should store a rooted address (address.py's own warning)

title: A question answered by measurement cites a record every box can find later: the answer door records --measured as a root
